scope: legacy 5 GB watcher and queue paths

findings.status: fail for concurrent admission; does not block the current zero-active solo launch

findings.consequence: Current checks can admit work that can exceed the 17 GB committed target as existing admitted workers grow into their reservations.
findings.resolution: Before concurrent admission, add unused active-worker reservation headroom to measured parent use without double-counting each active worker's current cgroup usage; fail closed when that usage cannot be established.

findings.consequence: A campaign spec cannot widen or falsify the controller's reserve policy using environment injection.
